title: SREV-027 WFP classify logging IRQL contract

classify_irql_shape.description: WFP classifyFn may run at IRQL <= DISPATCH_LEVEL

rtl_stringcb_shape.description: RtlStringCbPrintfA/W may run at any IRQL only when all manipulated strings are always resident; otherwise caller must be at PASSIVE_LEVEL

lock_irql_shapes.description: KeAcquireSpinLockRaiseToDpc raises to the spin-lock/DPC path; ExAcquireResourceExclusiveLite requires IRQL <= APC_LEVEL; paged-pool memory cannot be touched at DISPATCH_LEVEL

forbidden_edge.description: DISPATCH-level WFP_classify -> Session_MonitorPutEx -> ERESOURCE + PagedPool monitor buffer is forbidden

deferred_logger_requirement.description: NetFwTrace logging needs a different executor: nonpaged queue/ring consumed later at PASSIVE_LEVEL, or a monitor subsystem whose full write path is legal at DISPATCH_LEVEL

source_change.description: Inactive inline logging implementation removed from WFP_classify; WFP_classify now enqueues fixed nonpaged trace records through WFP_TraceEnqueueFromClassify when NetFwTrace is enabled; WFP_TraceThreadProc drains the bounded queue and formats monitor strings outside classify before calling Session_MonitorPut

runtime_matrix.description: If NetFwTrace is later implemented, run Driver Verifier IRQL/DDI checking with sustained IPv4/IPv6 TCP/UDP loopback/non-loopback blocked/permitted traffic, NetFwTrace on/off, rule refresh, process churn, monitor-log readback, and negative controls proving no inline Session_MonitorPut or RtlStringCbPrintf calls

shared_runtime_capture_schema.description: Runtime evidence records use docs/plan/srev-022-027-kernel-runtime-capture.schema.json with feature_path wfp-deferred-logger

contracts: WFP_classify must not call Session_MonitorPut or Session_MonitorPutEx
WFP_classify must not call RtlStringCbPrintfA or RtlStringCbPrintfW
Source must provide an executable deferred logger path before NetFwTrace records are written
Runtime matrix must require Driver Verifier IRQL/DDI checking, traffic stress, monitor readback, negative controls, and logging-disabled regression
Deferred logger design must separate DISPATCH_LEVEL nonpaged classify-side capture from PASSIVE_LEVEL monitor formatting and writeback
Ledger records source-level deferred logger path and remaining Windows runtime proof gate
shared kernel runtime capture records must use feature_path wfp-deferred-logger

settings: rule refresh while traffic is active
synchronization_owner: DISPATCH-safe producer lock or lock-free queue
deferred_executor: calls Session_MonitorPut or Session_MonitorPutEx outside classify
drains or cancels on WFP unload
negative_controls: logging disabled path preserves block permit decisions
